name: Sunflower Oil
subtitle: Refined & Deodorized · Premium Grade
description: 100% pure refined & deodorized sunflower oil. Standard & High Oleic variants available. Ideal for frying, baking, and industrial use.
longDescription: Grannex Foods Sunflower Oil is a 100% pure, refined and deodorized premium cooking oil — never blended with other oils. Produced using advanced hot pressing technology (seeds heated to 130–140°C), the oil delivers maximum extraction while preserving natural flavour and nutritional properties. Deodorized for a neutral taste and aroma, it is the ideal choice for high-heat frying, baking, catering, and industrial food production. Sourced from certified producers to guarantee consistent, top-tier quality for every batch. Available in Standard and High Oleic variants.
